frame.note: Authored y is up. The loader converts y once into the SVG frame. Null positions stay null and are not drawn.

w_mm.note: Overall width on the drawing. The computers documentation also says approximately 65 mm × 30 mm.

hole_spec.note: Drawing note: all holes M2.5. Centers were not recovered reliably from the vector file, so they are not drawn.

measurement.note: The PDF text layer has no dimensions. Straight edges in the vector drawing were scaled so the long straight (between the 3 mm fillets) is 59 mm. The short straight then measures 24 mm, which is 30 mm minus two fillets. The rectangle closes at 65 mm × 30 mm.

anchors.note: The header is documented as 2×20 at 2.54 mm, but pin 1 has no published coordinate in the files reviewed here.
Right short edge. Coordinate is null, so the slot is not drawn.
Bottom edge, between mini HDMI and USB power. Coordinate is null, so the socket is not drawn.
Bottom edge, right of the OTG socket. Coordinate is null, so the socket is not drawn.
Left short edge; the card overhangs to the left. Coordinate is null, so the slot is not drawn.

claims.note: Zero W and WH section. The Zero 2 W section says Bluetooth was upgraded from 4.0 to 4.2.
Introduction, stated for every Zero model with a W suffix, including Zero 2 W.

disagreements.note: Official pages disagree. This file does not pick a version.

claims.note: Said of every wireless Zero model, including Zero 2 W. The 35 Mb/s figure is not repeated on the product page.

disagreements.note: 2.4 GHz only is consistent. The air standard and the 35 Mb/s figure are not worded the same way.

same: Same connectors and mounting holes as Zero W

different.zero_2w: RP3A0 system-in-package: BCM2710A1 plus 512 MB LPDDR2

different.zero_w: 32-bit only. A 64-bit OS image is not for this board.

compare_zero_2w.ram_note: Zero W documentation lists 512 MB LPDDR2 at 450 MHz as its own line. The RP3A0 page says the original Zero uses package-on-package DRAM on the BCM2835. It does not repeat that sentence for Zero W, so this file does not assert a PoP stack for the W.

summary.en: The board outline is 65 mm by 30 mm with a 3 mm corner radius. Mounting holes are specified M2.5. Their centers are not in this file.
summary.es: El contorno mide 65 mm por 30 mm, con radio de esquina de 3 mm. Los taladros son M2.5. Sus centros no están en este archivo.

summary.en: Broadcom BCM2835. The Zero W page in the computers documentation calls it the processor package and lists the RAM separately. Placement on the PCB is not dimensioned here.
summary.es: Broadcom BCM2835. La documentación lista la RAM aparte. La posición en la PCB no está acotada aquí.

facts.note: The Pi pages say 32-bit ARM11. ARMv6 is the architecture named by the ARM1176JZF-S manual linked from those pages.

summary.en: The only CPU core in the BCM2835. It is not the Cortex-A53 in the Zero 2 W.
summary.es: El único núcleo del BCM2835. No es el Cortex-A53 del Zero 2 W.

summary.en: 400 MHz VideoCore IV, the same GPU family the Zero 2 W documentation names.
summary.es: VideoCore IV a 400 MHz, la misma familia de GPU que nombra la documentación del Zero 2 W.

summary.en: 512 MB of LPDDR2 at 450 MHz. The vendor mark on the package was not read from an official drawing, so it is not named here.
summary.es: 512 MB de LPDDR2 a 450 MHz. No se nombra el fabricante del encapsulado porque no sale en el plano oficial.

facts.note: Package-on-package is stated for the original Zero, not in the Zero W paragraph.

summary.en: The official component table says “a radio module” for Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. It does not print a chip number. A part number is not invented here.
summary.es: La tabla oficial dice «un módulo de radio» para Wi-Fi y Bluetooth. No imprime un número de chip. Aquí no se inventa.

facts.note: Not named in the Zero W component table.

summary.en: 2.4 GHz only. There is no 5 GHz radio on this board. Do not treat a 5 GHz-only network as reachable.
summary.es: Solo 2,4 GHz. Esta placa no tiene radio de 5 GHz.

summary.en: Classic Bluetooth plus BLE. The version number is in conflict between official pages, so it is left blank.
summary.es: Bluetooth clásico y BLE. La versión está en conflicto entre páginas oficiales, así que se deja en blanco.

summary.en: No antenna and no keep-out are drawn. A previously suggested x range was not trusted, and the mechanical extract did not yield a keep-out polygon.
summary.es: La radio necesita antena. El plano revisado no dio un polígono de exclusión con coordenadas citables, así que el cobre no se dibuja.

summary.en: Unpopulated 2×20 holes at 2.54 mm. Pin 1 is 3V3. GPIO logic is 3.3 V and is not 5 V tolerant. Zero WH is the same board with the header already soldered.
summary.es: Taladros 2×20 sin poblar, a 2,54 mm. El pin 1 es 3V3. La lógica es de 3,3 V y no tolera 5 V. El Zero WH es la misma placa con el header ya soldado.

facts.note: Estimated pad diameter for the inspector only. Not drawn, and not a callout on the mechanical drawing text layer.
Estimated drill for the inspector only. Not drawn.

summary.en: The schematic labels a green LED “STATUS ACT LED” on the net STATUS_LED. There is no separate power LED in that note.
summary.es: El esquema rotula un LED verde «STATUS ACT LED» en la red STATUS_LED. Esa nota no muestra un LED de alimentación aparte.

facts.note: The mark printed next to the LED on the schematic. Not a full order code.

summary.en: U3 on the rev 1.1 schematic is a PAM2306AYPKE, with 5 V, 3.3 V and 1.8 V nets around it. Its maximum current is not stated on that sheet.
summary.es: U3 en el esquema rev 1.1 es un PAM2306AYPKE, con redes de 5 V, 3,3 V y 1,8 V. Esa hoja no indica su corriente máxima.

facts.note: Not printed on the schematic sheet.

summary.en: X1 is marked 19.2 MHz on the schematic, with 18 pF capacitors on the XTAL nets.
summary.es: X1 está marcado a 19,2 MHz en el esquema, con condensadores de 18 pF en las redes XTAL.

summary.en: One mini HDMI port, video and audio, up to 1080p60. Connector J6 on the schematic. Individual contact numbers beyond the nets listed on that sheet are not fully extracted here.
summary.es: Un puerto mini HDMI, vídeo y audio, hasta 1080p60. Conector J6 en el esquema. Los contactos que no se leyeron con claridad no se numeran aquí.

summary.en: Two micro-USB ports: one for power, one OTG for devices. There is no Ethernet jack.
summary.es: Dos puertos micro-USB: uno de alimentación y uno OTG. No hay Ethernet.

facts.note: The Zero W section says there is no wired Ethernet port.

summary.en: A 2-lane MIPI CSI port: 22 pins, 0.5 mm pitch, 11.5 mm wide. The cable packed with a standard camera does not fit.
summary.es: CSI MIPI de 2 carriles: 22 pines, paso 0,5 mm, 11,5 mm de ancho. El cable de una cámara estándar no entra.

summary.en: The operating system and files live on a microSD card. The slot outline is not dimensioned in this file.
summary.es: El sistema y los archivos van en una microSD. El contorno de la ranura no está acotado en este archivo.

summary.en: The schematic shows a RUN net. The product page lists a reset header. The sentence “connect RUN to GND to reset” is published in the Zero 2 W test-pad table, not in the Zero W paragraph, so it is not copied across as a Zero W fact.
summary.es: El esquema muestra la red RUN. La página del producto lista un header de reset. La frase de unir RUN a GND está en la tabla del Zero 2 W, no en el párrafo del Zero W, y no se copia como hecho del W.

facts.note: Explicitly tabulated for Zero 2 W only.

summary.en: The product page lists composite video and reset headers. A TV net was not cleanly read from the schematic text extract, so the pad coordinate and pin list are null.
summary.es: La página del producto lista headers de vídeo compuesto y de reset. La red TV no se leyó con claridad en el extracto del esquema, así que la coordenada queda nula.

facts.note: Header exists as a product feature. Contact list not extracted.
